_note: Blender camera reproducing the banc-explorer Neuroglancer framing. World units are MICROMETRES: import the nm OBJs and scale by 0.001. matrix_world is row-major 4x4, ready for Matrix(...) in Blender.
_lens_note: sensor_fit MUST be VERTICAL. Blender's default AUTO fits the LARGER axis, which on a 4:3 landscape frame is the width, and the subject would be framed on the wrong axis.
provenance: invViewMatrix + viewProjectionMat read from the live spelunker.cave-explorer.org perspective panel sized to 1600x1200
